summary: Silo Pharma filed an 8-K reporting it received Nasdaq confirmation that it regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule (Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)) as of June 17, 2026. The company's closing bid price had been at $1.00 or greater from June 3 to June 16, 2026. No terms, prices, premiums, or advisors are involved. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. The filing simply closes the bid price deficiency matter and includes a press release. No deal mechanics, structural notes, or risk-arb angles apply.
